market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI crude is ~$98 on Apr 28, 2026, with 52-week high $117.63 (already below $140). Reaching $140 in 2 months requires ~43% rally — would need full Middle East war / Strait of Hormuz closure. Tail-risk only. Estimate ~2-4%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major geopolitical disruption (Strait of Hormuz / Iran war) is the only path to $140.
